title: fusion.entry-result/v1
description: fusion's proposal in request 76, not yet accepted by Prior: the result of the run step of fusion.entry.v1 and the module's envelope for the invocation, bound by workflows/entry.v1.json whatever the entry's profile declares (decision 261023-1854-which-schemas-bind-an-entry-run-of-an-agent-that-is-also-a-workflow-role, option 1). status takes four values: completed, the run ended in success and every step after it completed; refused, the invocation, admission, an answer or a host step refused, with the reason in violations; recovery-required, a role or host effect is unknown or in flight, never a fabricated answer and never a terminal refusal written to end the run; ended, the run stopped, the user having ended the session through a question (Prior's question outcome ended) or by the stop the entry offers, which is neither a success nor an interruption that discards the workspace. ending is how the run ended in the class and reason form of Prior's fusion-surface comparison (internal/qualification/fusionsurface Ending), null only on recovery-required, which is no ending. questions are the run's host.question.v1 calls with their answers, in call order; commits the integration's commits; both are read from the host's receipts and copied, never composed by the model. Settlement is not acceptance: a settled run whose answer was refused stays settled, and a retry is a new invocation with a new workflow_id and run_id. No $schema keyword: the host compiles every bundle schema as draft 2020-12 and this file must carry no URL.

class.description: success, the role produced its final answer; refusal, the run or a step refused; stop, the run stopped before its final answer.

reason.description: A reason category, lowercase and hyphenated, such as stopped-by-user; never free model text.

questions.description: One entry per host.question.v1 call of the run, in call order; empty when the run asked nothing.

call_id.description: The call's slot within the run.

options.description: The call's options; empty on the chat-text channel.

selected.description: The options chosen, each among options; empty unless outcome is answered on ask-user-question.

text.description: The answer's text; empty unless outcome is answered.

commits.description: The commits the integrate step put on the accepted reference, oldest first; empty when the capture was empty or the run did not reach integration.

reference.description: The accepted local reference the commit advanced.

changes.description: One per changed path, "<status>\t<path>" in git's name-status form, from the snapshot's changed_paths.

violations.description: Why the answer is not completed; empty on completed.
